end.summary:
Named an earthworm as a small animal found in soil.
Discussed that ants have six legs and are insects.
Pihu said earthworms harm soil; this mix-up was not corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; lesson ended after 1.4 minutes.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small animals in soil and leaf litter, using examples such as earthworms and ants. Pihu identified an earthworm and recalled that insects have six legs. They said earthworms harm soil, and this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, look at a picture of an earthworm together and discuss how it helps soil.
